title: [.Net] Cannot Remove EditorDock when unloading ALC
body:
### Tested versions

v4.6.1.stable.mono.official [14d19694e]

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable.mono - Windows 10 (build 19044) - Multi-window, 4 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8097) - AMD Ryzen 9 7950X 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 63.05 GiB memory

### Issue description

The EditorDock instance of a C# EditorPlugin is already in a disposed state when the `Unloading` event of the current ALC gets triggered (e.g., after building the C# code), so there is effectively no way of removing a dock when C# is unloading.

The current MRP project emits the following when rebuilding the delegate-related messages is not in the scope of the current issue and should be discussed in #117145 :
